t: Home Ownership Scheme - Wikipedia
s: November 28, 2025 - The Home Ownership Scheme (HOS) is a subsidised-sale public housing programme managed by the Hong Kong Housing Authority. It was instituted in the late 1970s as part of the government policy for public housing with two aims – to encourage better-off tenants of rental flats to vacate those flats for re-allocation to families in greater housing need, and to provide an opportunity for home ownership to families unable to afford to buy in the private sector.
